# openwebui_admin_config (Resource)

Manages the instance-wide administrative settings of Open WebUI: signup, the default user role, API keys, token expiry, and the feature switches for folders, automations, channels, calendar, memories, and notes.

Open WebUI drops a value it considers invalid and still answers 200, so the default user role, the channel response mode, and the token expiry are validated here instead. A rejected value fails the plan rather than applying as a silent no-op.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Settings this resource does not name keep the values the instance already
# holds, so a configuration can manage as few of them as it likes.
resource "openwebui_admin_config" "example" {
  webui_url         = "https://chat.example.com"
  enable_signup     = false
  default_user_role = "pending"
  jwt_expires_in    = "7d"

  enable_channels             = true
  channel_model_response_mode = "thread"
  enable_notes                = true
  enable_folders              = true

  # Open WebUI stores 0 as empty for these three, so an empty string is the way
  # to say "no limit".
  folder_max_file_count   = "50"
  automation_max_count    = ""
  automation_min_interval = "300"

  pending_user_overlay_title   = "Waiting for approval"
  pending_user_overlay_content = "An administrator reviews every new account."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `admin_email` (String) Contact address shown to users waiting for approval.
- `api_keys_allowed_endpoints` (String) Comma-separated endpoints an API key may call. Applies when `enable_api_keys_endpoint_restrictions` is true.
- `automation_max_count` (String) Maximum number of automations per user, as a string. Empty means no limit.
- `automation_min_interval` (String) Shortest interval an automation may run on, in seconds, as a string. Empty means no floor.
- `channel_model_response_mode` (String) Where a model answers in a channel: `thread` or `channel`.
- `default_group_id` (String) Identifier of the group every new account joins. Empty for none.
- `default_user_role` (String) Role given to a new account: `pending`, `user`, or `admin`.
- `enable_api_keys` (Boolean) Whether users can mint API keys.
- `enable_api_keys_endpoint_restrictions` (Boolean) Whether API keys are limited to the endpoints named in `api_keys_allowed_endpoints`.
- `enable_automations` (Boolean) Whether users can create automations.
- `enable_calendar` (Boolean) Whether the calendar feature is available.
- `enable_channels` (Boolean) Whether the channels feature is available. The `openwebui_channel` resource needs this on.
- `enable_community_sharing` (Boolean) Whether users can share chats to the Open WebUI community site.
- `enable_folders` (Boolean) Whether users can organise chats into folders.
- `enable_memories` (Boolean) Whether the memories feature is available.
- `enable_memory_system_context` (Boolean) Whether memories are added to the system context of a chat.
- `enable_message_rating` (Boolean) Whether users can rate model responses.
- `enable_notes` (Boolean) Whether the notes feature is available.
- `enable_signup` (Boolean) Whether visitors can create their own accounts.
- `enable_user_status` (Boolean) Whether users publish an online status.
- `enable_user_webhooks` (Boolean) Whether users can register their own webhooks.
- `folder_max_file_count` (String) Maximum number of files in a folder, as a string. Empty means no limit; Open WebUI stores 0 as empty, so it is not a value this attribute can hold.
- `jwt_expires_in` (String) Session token lifetime, e.g. `4h` or `30d`. Use `-1` for no expiry.
- `pending_user_overlay_content` (String) Body text shown to an account that is still pending approval.
- `pending_user_overlay_title` (String) Heading shown to an account that is still pending approval.
- `response_watermark` (String) Watermark text added to copied model responses.
- `show_admin_details` (Boolean) Whether the sign-in page shows the administrator's contact details.
- `webui_url` (String) Public URL of this Open WebUI instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this singleton resource. Always `admin`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Open WebUI holds one set of admin settings, so this resource is a singleton.
# Import it under its fixed id.
terraform import openwebui_admin_config.example admin
```
